unit.why: The division is a kabbalistic and segulah note on the hymn 'Ish Hasid', about its authorship by R. Yishai son of the Levush, the divine name encoded in it, and its power for livelihood. The dream-question in which the angel Gabriel names the source is only a brief provenance remark, not a developed narrative.
unit.boundary_note: Continues the segulah discussion of 'Ish Hasid' from the previous division (Or la-Shamayim); the next division starts a new segulah topic.
